Index.title: While you were searching for what to watch, the movie could have been over by now.
Index.subtitle: Honestly? We all burn at least 40 minutes just scrolling, hesitating, and eventually falling asleep on the remote.
Index.description: So....... CineMind is here to cut the bullshit. Through a light 20-question quiz, our insane algorithm reads your mind (yes, exactly like that, I saw that smile, stop playing) and drops the exact movie you HAVE to watch right now, but like RIGHT right now, yeah? Because if not now, you'll postpone to tomorrow and tomorrow to later and... enough, it's time to watch a good movie.

Terms.title: Terms of Use (TOS)
Terms.s1_p: Welcome to CineMind. Use of the site, the app and our recommendation system is subject to your acceptance of the terms set out here. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use the service.
Terms.s2_h: 2. Disclaimer - artificial intelligence and content recommendations
Terms.s2_p: The CineMind system is based on artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms and statistical models for recommending films. We <warn>make no commitment</warn> that the recommended film will match your taste precisely, or that it will be free of content that may upset you. The choice to watch a film is the user's responsibility alone, and the company disclaims any liability for damage, distress or lost time resulting from a wrong recommendation.
Terms.s3_p: CineMind offers a single plan: Founder — a one-time payment of ₪99 including VAT, which grants lifetime access to the account it was purchased for. The plan is limited to 200 seats, and once they are gone it closes for purchase. There is no subscription here, no recurring charge and no automatic renewal — you pay once and that is it. Any other plan or price offered in the future will bind only those who buy it, and will not retroactively change what has already been purchased.
Terms.s4_intro: The purchase is a distance sale transaction under the Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981 [חוק הגנת הצרכן, התשמ״א-1981], and you have a full right of cancellation:
Terms.s4_li1: 14 days to cancel. You may cancel the purchase within 14 days of the transaction date or of the date you received the transaction details document, whichever is later. On cancellation we will refund the payment, and we are permitted to deduct a cancellation fee of 5% of the price or ₪100 — whichever is lower.
Terms.s4_li2: How to cancel. Email with the name and the email address you registered with. You may also cancel by phone or by post to the address in section 8. We will refund within 14 days of receiving the cancellation notice.
Terms.s4_li3: Extended cancellation. A person with a disability, a senior citizen or a new immigrant may cancel within 4 months of the transaction date, subject to presenting a certificate.
Terms.s4_li4: Continuing transaction. If in the future we offer a service with a recurring charge, it will be cancellable at any moment, and the charge will stop within 3 business days from the delivery of the cancellation notice (or within 6 business days if it was sent by registered mail).
Terms.s4_close: A service already used does not reduce the right of cancellation. If anything in these terms conflicts with the Consumer Protection Law [חוק הגנת הצרכן] — the law prevails.
Terms.s5_p: The service is intended for ages 18 and over. Under the age of 18, use is permitted only with the consent of a parent or guardian, who is also the one making the purchase. The system shows films of every age rating, including content that is not suitable for minors, and we do not filter by age. A parent who discovers that their child registered without their consent is welcome to contact us, and we will delete the account and the data collected.
Terms.s6_p: CineMind does not store the customer's credit card details. All payment processing is carried out encrypted and under the strictest PCI-DSS standard through the international payment company Stripe.
Terms.s7_p: All intellectual property rights in the site, including the brand, the design (UI/UX), the question engine and the "micro-genre" algorithm, belong to CineMind. Copying, reproduction or commercial use without written permission is strictly prohibited. Film data, posters and synopses come from TMDB and remain the property of their owners.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_h: 1. What we do with your information
Privacy.s1_p: We do not sell your information and we do not rent it to advertisers. For the service to work we do pass information to providers that run it for us — they process it under our instructions only. The list is in section 3.
Privacy.s2_p: We collect your email address, your answers to the taste questionnaires, film ratings, recommendation history and the "micro-genre" profile built from them. We also collect technical usage information: browser type, device, IP address and usage events on the site. The information is used to run the recommendation engine, to send the emails you asked for and to improve the product.
Privacy.s3_li1: Firebase (Google) — registration, login and storage of the user profile and ratings.
Privacy.s3_li2: Stripe — payment processing. Card details are given directly to Stripe and do not pass through us.
Privacy.s3_li3: Resend — sending the emails from the system.
Privacy.s3_li5: TMDB — the source of the film data. We send TMDB queries about films, not identifying details about you.
Privacy.s3_close: These providers' servers are located outside Israel, mainly in the United States and the European Union, so the information is also stored and processed abroad. Use of the service constitutes consent to that transfer.
Privacy.s4_p: We use cookies for two purposes. The first is managing the login and keeping your status, so you do not have to log in again on every visit. The second is product analytics through PostHog, which loads on every page and records which screens were viewed, which buttons were clicked and how you progressed through the questionnaire. We read this to understand where people get stuck and what to fix. We do not run advertising networks and we do not pass this data to advertisers. You can block the cookies in your browser settings, and then parts of the service will not work as usual.
Privacy.s5_p: After registration we send you an email once a week with one film chosen according to your profile, as well as operational emails such as a purchase confirmation or a password reset. To unsubscribe from the weekly mailing you can click the unsubscribe link at the bottom of every email, or send a request to <mail></mail>. Unsubscribing from the mailing does not cancel the operational emails and does not close the account.
Privacy.s6_h: 6. How long we keep the information
Privacy.s6_p: The user profile and the ratings are kept as long as the account is active. If you asked for deletion, we will delete them within 30 days. An account unused for three years will be deleted on our initiative. Analytics data is kept in PostHog for up to 12 months. Payment records and invoices are kept for seven years as required by tax law.
Privacy.s7_p: You have the right to review the information we have collected about you, to correct it or to delete it entirely, including your cinematic DNA. To do so, send a request from the email address you registered with to <mail></mail>, and we will handle it within 30 days. If you did not receive a satisfactory answer, you may contact the Privacy Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice.
